card.title: Poco X3 Pro No Light After 2 SecondS Of Powering ON

source.title: Poco X3 Pro No Light After 2 SecondS Of Powering ON

claims.statement: Poco X3 Pro losing backlight 1–2 s after the logo has a broken DISPLAY_CABC (PWM brightness) line; it should read about 0.610 in diode mode—high/OL confirms.
Fix by lifting the PMIC and jumpering the CABC pad under it to the display connector pin.

procedure: Remove PMIC; jumper CABC pad to the connector.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
